jobs.title: Big announcement!
jobs.description: BLOG 8fig joins the Bizcap Group: a new chapter for smarter, faster funding October 21, 2025 Contents Introducing the Double F: More Funds. Much Faster. We’re excited to share an important milestone – 8fig has joined the Bizcap Group, marking a major step forward in our mission to help small and medium-sized businesses access capital. Now, 8fig customers can access more funds, even faster – starting today. Introducing the Double F: More Funds. Much Faster. By combining Bizcap’s global reach and financial strength with 8fig’s AI-driven technology and funding automation, we’ll be able to serve more entrepreneurs around the world and accelerate innovation in business finance. At 8fig, we were the first to disrupt small and medium-sized business funding with true automatic underwriting, creating the first self-serve AI funding platform – fast, automatic, and built to empower entrepreneurs with tailored funding. By solving one of the toughest challenges in business finance – underwriting at scale – we’ve redefined how small businesses access capital, making funding smarter, faster, and more flexible than ever before. This partnership brings together the best of both worlds – the intelligence of 8fig’s automation and the strength of Bizcap’s capital – to shape the future of small-business funding. The next chapter starts here, where technology meets capital, and every business gains the power to grow with confidence. To learn more about Bizcap, visit bizcap.com.au Team 8fig Team 8fig is an experienced group of eCommerce writers and experts committed to helping online sellers grow their businesses through informative content and guides. jobs.title: About us All about 8fig
jobs.description: Home > About us We help sellers grow 8fig supports small eCommerce businesses in achieving growth by addressing cash flow challenges. Our AI CFO technology and tailored funding solutions empower them to reach their potential. Based in Miami and Tel Aviv, we are passionate about our customers’ success. Sound interesting? Join us! What have we been up to? Since launching 8fig, we’ve built a team of eCommerce specialists, partnered with industry leaders, and created financing tools that empower sellers to elevate their businesses. Founded in 2020 8fig was founded by serial entrepreneurs and eCommerce experts Yaron Shapira, Assaf Dagan, and Roei Yellin. Raised $196.5 million Our all-equity Series A and B funding rounds, led by Battery Ventures, LocalGlobe, and Koch, raised $250 million. Established global teams 8fig has teams in Tel Aviv, Israel (R&D and product) and Miami, Florida (growth, marketing, and CS).
